n2a5b4d80f3.headline: Government has no business to be in business: Vedanta chief Anil Agarwal
n2a5b4d80f3.summary: Anil Agarwal, head of Vedanta, stated that the government has no business being involved in banks and companies where it holds significant stakes in India.
n2a5b4d80f3.why: Government ownership in companies and banks affects market dynamics, privatization debates, and investor perceptions in India.

ne6ffae5b69.headline: The EU Agrees To Cut Emissions To Net Zero By 2050
ne6ffae5b69.summary: The EU agreed to reduce total emissions to net zero by 2050 after lengthy debates, with Eastern European states demanding financial support. Poland was the only member state excluded from the agreement.
ne6ffae5b69.why: The EU's net-zero target shapes energy, industrial, and regulatory policies impacting companies and markets across Europe and globally.
ne6ffae5b69.why_moved: The EU's net-zero commitment signals major regulatory shifts affecting energy and industrial sectors, influencing market valuations and investment flows.
